listing.name: Doom / GZDoom (ZDoom)
listing.summary: Play compatible Doom-engine games with GZDoom’s modern display, audio and mod support using your own game files.

steps.title: Use the Windows player ZIP
steps.instruction: Choose the Windows runtime ZIP. Finish setup with gzdoom.exe in the extracted game folder. Keep your original game files and mods available.

steps.title: Choose your original game
steps.instruction: On first Play, choose a compatible game IWAD detected by GZDoom. Follow upstream’s IWAD instructions if your game is not detected; the engine and original game files are separate.

steps.title: Keep your profile and saved games
steps.instruction: GZDoom normally keeps Windows settings in Documents/My Games/GZDoom and saved games in Saved Games/GZDoom. Portable mode uses gzdoom_portable.ini and Save beside the player instead. Keep the locations you use, original files and mods backed up when updating the upstream runtime.
